linux.download.title: Prepare your Linux installation
linux.download.description: Choose the target computer. The ZIP will include compatible files and a tool to install and uninstall them.
linux.download.previewError: This combination could not be prepared. Check the distribution and architecture; if you chose a specific version, try another compatible source.
linux.download.instructions: Nothing will be installed when downloading. Native packages will request sudo; portable applications will be installed for your user.
linux.download.extract: Extract the ZIP, check README.md and open a terminal in that folder:
linux.download.persisted: The installer saves its log so you can uninstall even after deleting the ZIP.
linux.support.manual: Manual installation - requires an approved recipe
linux.admin.title: Linux installation and dependencies
linux.admin.description: Declarative JSON recipes, without shell commands. TAR.GZ and JAR require entrypoint. Approved changes apply to future downloads; dependencies are edited separately.
linux.admin.dependencies: Dependencies: one application UUID per line
linux.admin.saved: Saved. It will be used in future downloads.
linux.admin.error: Could not save or load. Review the JSON, UUIDs, and loops. If someone else modified the recipe, reopen this panel before saving.
